1521179.steps:
1. In Device \ Log \ Settings page, enable log with id 1686 'DNS Filtering - DNS Packet Allowed' in Network \ DNS Security, click edit, set Logging level to Inform, set Display Events in Log Monitor to 0 seconds, accept;
2. Profile Objects \ DNS Filtering, add a profile named "test", the action of category "Gaming" is Forged IP reply / Negative Reply / Block;
3. Rules and Policies \ DNS Rules, enable a DNS Policy : Action-Filter, Interface-X0, Profile-"test";
4. DNS Security \ DNS Filtering, set a valid Forged IP address 10.0.0.1/1001::1;

5. DNS Security \ White List, add a domain: www.ea.com, enable white list in DNS Filtering tab;
6. PC connected to X0, set dns server as X0 IP, do dig a www.ea.com, check the result;
7. Do packet capture on DUT, Check DNS packets and System logs;
1521179.initial:
PC---(X0)DUT(X1)---WAN
WAN access to Neustar Server(156.154.54/55.200)
1521179.title: [FUNC] Verify when White List is enabled, the action of the domain in White List will not be enforced and log shows.
1521179.result: In step 6-7, the action is not enforced, and a log 'DNS Filtering - DNS Packet Bypassed via Whitelist' displays.

1521180.steps:

3. DNS Security \ DNS Filtering,enable white list,andset a valid Forged IP address 10.0.0.1/1001::1;
